quests.title: Yavanani's Apples

dialogue.t: Language is the foundation of all forms of sociological and historical studies. It makes perfect sense to approach the issue from a linguistic point of view. How stubborn of them to not see that...
Effendi reminded me to explain details about my request in a comprehensible manner...
I'll get right to it, then. Have you got the five Apples?

dialogue.sit: Here are the apples you wanted.

dialogue.t: Thank you. It's pretty easy to post requests with Effendi. Not much explanation necessary.

quests.description: Yavanani from Sumeru City needs five Apples.
